scripts.build:chromium: mkdir -p dist/chromium && cp chromium/manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.js options.html options.js region-data.js LICENSE -t dist/chromium/ && cp -r _locales src icons dist/chromium/ && cd dist/chromium && zip -rq ../../googlesearch-force-region-chromium.zip . && cd ../.. && rm -rf dist
scripts.build:firefox: mkdir -p dist/firefox && cp firefox/manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.js options.html options.js region-data.js LICENSE -t dist/firefox/ && cp -r _locales src icons dist/firefox/ && cd dist/firefox && zip -rq ../../googlesearch-force-region-firefox.zip . && cd ../.. && rm -rf dist
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run build:chromium && npm run build:firefox
